instance.finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/details-plugin.ts::plugin ordering: `listemptybulletplugin` runs after `detailsplugin` and re-registers `list`/`lheading`, clobbering any alt chain or wrapper those earlier plugins installed on the same rules

finding.summary: Plugin ordering: `listEmptyBulletPlugin` runs after `detailsPlugin` and re-registers `list`/`lheading`, clobbering any alt chain or wrapper those earlier plugins installed on the same rules
finding.evidence: `preview.ts` applies plugins in sequence — `md.use(detailsPlugin)` (preview.ts:43) then `md.use(listEmptyBulletPlugin)` (preview.ts:47) — and the new plugin calls `md.block.ruler.at('lheading', ...)` (list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts:175) and `md.block.ruler.at('list', ...)` (:197) which overwrite both the fn and the alt chain of those rules. `getRuleFn(md, 'list')` (:179) captures whatever fn is installed at that moment, so a `list` wrapper from `detailsPlugin` survives, but `lheading` is replaced outright with no delegation and the restored `alt` for `list` is hardcoded to markdown-it's stock `['paragraph','reference','blockquote']` — dropping any alt membership (e.g. a `details` context) an earlier plugin added. `details-plugin.ts` is not in the diff and is not present in this checkout, so I could not verify whether it touches `list`/`lheading`; the new file's header comment references it (`same note as in \`details-plugin.ts\``), confirming it exists. To confirm, open `packages/notes/src/view/details-plugin.ts` and grep it for `block.ruler`, `ruler.at`, `ruler.before`, and `alt:`.
